about.title: About us
about.intro: NutriPlant PRO is a technical platform focused on improving decision-making in plant nutrition by integrating agronomic knowledge, analysis, and technology. We promote technical judgment, continuous learning, and a professional community that values rigor, honesty, and constant improvement.
about.vision_body: To be the reference platform for design, analysis, and decision-making in plant nutrition, integrating agronomic knowledge, technology, and artificial intelligence, and building a global technical community that values rigor, precision, and continuous improvement.
about.mission_body: To raise the technical standard in plant nutrition by providing tools, knowledge, and analysis based on scientific foundations, enabling agronomists and technicians to make better decisions when formulating nutritional programs.
about.value_criterion: Think before applying. Decide with a solid basis.
about.value_respect: For the process, for people, and for knowledge under construction.
about.value_honesty: Speak clearly, without empty promises or half-truths.

radar.coords_help: If a field is already saved, its coordinates appear here. You can copy, edit, or paste new ones. Accepts decimal and deg/min/sec (e.g. 19°40'51.2"N, 103°26'34.0"W). Minimum 3 points.

radar.how_built_html: pick 1 single Sentinel pass (the clearest over the field), without mixing dates or filling from others. Window 14 → 21 → 30 → 45 d; stop if ~100% useful; otherwise keep the best passes (≥~5%). Layers: NDVI, NDMI, NDRE, RGB and SCL clouds. Maximum 250 ha per field.

radar.scale_ndre_title: NDRE scale relative to the field
radar.scale_rgb_title: RGB true-color view of the field
radar.scale_ndvi_help: Green = higher vigor within the same field; red/orange = lower relative vigor.
radar.scale_ndmi_help: NDMI = relative moisture within the same field; interpret with NDVI, VPD, irrigation and field checks.
radar.scale_ndre_help: NDRE = chlorophyll and canopy status (red edge). Green/teal = higher; red/amber = lower within the same field.
radar.scale_rgb_help: RGB = true color (blue/green/red bands). Useful to locate the field and compare with indices.
radar.scale_clouds_help: SCL mask: white/gray = clouds, purple = shadow and blue = water. Transparent zones were clear.

radar.lectura_credits_title: Same Radar credit balance as Pilot
radar.lectura_intro_html: Build a history of the same field (2 to 6 periods back) with NDVI, NDMI, NDRE, RGB, VPD, ET₀, rainfall and your irrigation (m³ ↔ mm with strip %). Maximum 250 ha per field.
radar.lectura_how_built_html: per period pick 1 single Sentinel pass (the clearest; no median or fill across dates). Same period logic (biweekly/monthly; incomplete biweek may expand to the month). If incomplete (<~100% useful) it still shows the image and explains cloudiness + %; only if almost no coverage (<~5%) there is no image and only the reason. Climate/irrigation remain. Images are generated in the cloud in the background (like Pilot): you can close and later press “Show images”. Cost: 3 credits (4 if field >30 ha) for the whole query.
radar.btn_show_images_title: Fetch and show saved NDVI/NDMI/NDRE/RGB images, check pending periods and complete climate if missing.
radar.saved_blocks_help: If you generate another period block, the previous one stays here so you can keep viewing its table and images.
radar.chart_help: Left: NDVI / NDMI / NDRE. Right: mm (ET₀, ETc if Kc in Climate, rainfall, irrigation). Soft bars: period VPD hours (<0.5 blue, 0.5–1.5 green, >1.5 dark red). Total ≈ period hours (15 d = 360 h).

analysis.depth_title: Depth of the soil layer considered in the analysis (e.g. 0-20 cm)
analysis.reach_label_title: What portion of that soil layer is actually explored by crop roots. 100% = entire layer; 50% = only half (e.g. drip irrigation).
analysis.cic_params_title: CEC comes from the Exchangeable cations and CEC section (sum Ca+Mg+K+Na+Al+H). Display only.
analysis.ideal_ref_title: Fills the Ideal row with general reference values (OM, N-NO₃, P by method, Na, S, micronutrients). K, Ca and Mg are calculated from CEC (ideal meq and conversion to ppm).
analysis.kgha_diff_title: Difference in kg/ha: lab amount minus ideal. Negative = deficit to supply; positive = excess.
analysis.cic_sum_title: Calculated: sum of Ca+Mg+K+Na+Al+H (meq/100g or cmol⁺/kg)
analysis.soil_suggest_60_title: Prefills m³ up to 60% available water (target zone cap)
analysis.soil_suggest_cc_title: Prefills m³ up to field capacity (FC)
analysis.soil_m3_franja_title: Volume in m³ in the irrigated strip
